title: Run Rs Graphql Js React Sketchpad Pipeline
description: Rs in-memory kit, GraphQL semio-store, js Session, react SemioStoreKitLineHost + KitWasmMountProvider, sketchpad play env wiring; schema vs metabolism fixture.
summary: Aligned golden GraphQL Kit with RS and metabolism initialKit by adding version and improving kit JSON hydrate/projection. Added ParentStore::spawn_from_install_json_value so semio-store POST /install create+importFile accept full kit-store bundle JSON (e.g. metabolism.kit.semio.json) or bare initialKit DTOs; new semio-store test covers bundle install. Restored KitWasmMountProvider/useKitWasmHost in @semio/react and kitStoreFromKitStoreClient stub in @semio/js for sketchpad imports. Playground can use VITE_SEMIO_NATIVE_STORE=1 + VITE_SEMIO_STORE_URL with SemioStoreKitLineHost for RS→GraphQL→Session→React pipeline. cargo test -p semio-store: 5 passed.
